In the old days to be a sniper meant being an elite sharpshooter, the best of the best, with eagle eyes, nerves of steel, and iron asses. To ensure their one and only shot didn't sail by the target, they had to consider dozens of factors that could affect the bullet's path. Today, anyone who has the right cyberware and a padded bank account can be a deadeye marksman. This Tsunami sniper rifle patches target intel and magnified images directly into optical cyberware, and it can automatically compensate for deviations in projectile trajectory. The Ashura has the spotter built directly into the hardware.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Smart Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Improved Smart Ammunition. While connected to this weapon’s Smart Rebuild, the user gains a +1 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots made with this weapon. When using this weapon to make a Head Aimed Shot and rolling for damage, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries.

Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
